First release of this fork: [gitgiovik/mini-oled-dock 1.0.0](https://github.com/gitgiovik/mini-oled-dock/releases/tag/v1.0.0) with its open pull requests #1-#4 merged, plus new features of its own.

### New

- **Win key follows the pointer.** With Settings → Screen → **Pointer**, the Win key brings the bar to the display under the mouse pointer. If the bar is already visible on another display it moves there instead of hiding.
- **New Start menu, written from scratch.** A quick double tap of Win (second tap within 300 ms, the first one is not delayed) or a left click on the Start button opens it on the display under the pointer, which the native Start menu cannot do.
  - Lists every app of the native Start menu, classic programs and Store apps, in alphabetical order.
  - Type to search: names that start with the text come first. Enter launches the first result, arrows and the wheel move, Esc clears the search and then closes.
  - Its own pins: right click an app to pin / unpin it at the top (`start_pins` in the config, separate from the bar pins).
  - Right click on the Start button still opens the quick-links menu.
- **Start button and quick-links menu** (PR #1, by Desox).
- **Window previews** with live DWM thumbnails for apps with several windows (PR #2, by Desox).
- **Choose the display** the bar sits on (PR #3).
- **Tray:** AppBar QUERYPOS / SETPOS accepted from non-elevated apps, clearer logs (PR #4).

### Fixes

- **Clear all and the X did not remove notifications**: Windows refused `ClearNotifications` for an unpackaged exe (`0x80070490`) and the notifications came back half a second later. They are now removed from each app's notification history.
- **Clicking a notification did nothing**: it now brings the app that sent it to the front (or launches it; if the app cannot be found, the Windows notification centre opens) and removes the notification.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, copies itself to `%ProgramFiles%\mini-oled-dock` and starts with Windows. To update, run `--install` from the new `dock.exe`: the running dock is stopped and restarted from the new copy. Settings are kept.

### Known limitations

- A notification that has no tag can be removed on its own only when it is the only one of its app (Clear all always works).
- The exe is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn on the first run.
